AdminRequiredMessage:
Music Media Keys requires administrator privileges to reliably control media playback over elevated games and applications without Windows UIPI restrictions.

Please confirm the User Account Control (UAC) prompt to continue.
TooltipShowOverlay: Display a compact on-screen popup with track title, artist, album art and volume slider when switching songs.
VolumeStepPromptMessage: Enter the volume change percentage per hotkey press (from 1% to 100%):
VolumeStepInvalidMessage: Please enter an integer between 1 and 100.
TooltipVolumeStep: Volume change percentage per hotkey press.
SeekStepPromptMessage: Enter track seek step in seconds (from 1 to 300):
SeekStepInvalidMessage: Please enter an integer between 1 and 300.
TooltipSeekStep: Track seek duration for rewind / fast forward hotkeys.
TooltipSkipUacPrompt: Registers a task in Windows Task Scheduler to launch the application with administrator privileges in one click without UAC prompts.
TooltipCheckForUpdates: Look for a new version on GitHub once a day. Nothing is downloaded without your consent.
TooltipUpdateRateLimited: GitHub limits how often updates can be checked from one network. Try again in an hour.
UpdateCheckFailed: Could not reach GitHub. Check your internet connection.
TooltipUpdateReady: Restart to switch to the new version now. Otherwise it starts next time.
TooltipAutoStart: Start the app with Windows. The icon will appear in the system tray when the system loads.
AutoStartDisableNeedAdmin: Autostart is disabled in settings. Administrator rights are required to remove the scheduled task so the app does not start at Windows logon.
AutoStartDisableFailed: Failed to remove the autostart task from Task Scheduler.
AutoStartEnableNeedAdmin: To enable autostart, run the app as administrator and enable autostart again.
AutoStartPathUnknown: Could not determine the application path.
AutoStartPathInvalid: The application path is invalid or the file does not exist.
AutoStartUntrustedPath: Cannot enable autostart because the app is running from the Downloads or Temp folder. Please move the application to a permanent directory (such as Program Files or AppData).
TooltipAuto: Where to send commands. "Auto" detects the active app (Spotify or Yandex Music).
TooltipSystemMediaKeysOnly: Commands emulate system media keys and control the active Windows media session or the last app where a player was active. Specific player selection is ignored. Volume controls adjust the overall system volume.
TooltipStartWithWindowOpen: Open the settings window when the app starts.
TooltipBlockMediaKeysForBrowser: Media keys will not be sent to the browser. Other apps receive commands as usual. If you use other keys for music, media keys will not control the browser player.
TooltipOverlayHideInFullscreen: While a game or a video is full-screen, the overlay does not pop up by itself. The "Show overlay" hotkey still shows it.
TooltipAddActionHotkey: Add hotkey binding for an application command
TooltipDuplicateBinding: This combination is assigned to another action. Neither binding will work.
CapabilityRequiresModifier: Standard keys require at least one modifier (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Win).
WelcomeSubtitle: Configure basic parameters before first launch. Settings can be changed later in the application window.
WelcomeSubtitleTooltip: Initial setup allows you to set up essential parameters for comfortable usage. You can modify any setting later in the main window.
WelcomeAdminCardText: The application operates with administrator privileges for guaranteed key interception over all games and windows. Turn on "Launch without UAC prompts" to skip the Windows prompt on every start.
WelcomeAdminTooltip: Administrator privileges are required to intercept keys over games and elevated applications (UIPI), as well as to register the silent launch task in Windows Task Scheduler.
WelcomeAutostartTooltip: Start the app automatically with Windows.
WelcomeStartWithWindowTooltip: Open settings window on startup. If unchecked, the app starts quietly in the system tray.
WelcomeHotkeysHint: Click a field and press your key combination (modifiers required for standard keys). Right-click for presets.
HotkeysHint: Click a field and press a key combination. Right-click for presets or to clear.
TooltipTargetPlayer: Select the player controlled by media keys and volume control.
TooltipCustomPlayerProcess: Enter the player executable name (without .exe or full path) for targeting and per-app volume control.
TooltipVolumeDuckLevel: Target volume level when toggling "Duck player volume". Pressing the hotkey again restores the original level.
VolumeDuckLevelInvalidMessage: Please enter a whole number from 1 to 90.
TooltipOverlayShowOnTrackChange: Automatically show the overlay when the playing track changes.
TooltipPlayStartupSound: Play a soft short chord when the app starts and is ready to intercept keys.
CapabilityRequiresModifierExplanation: Windows blocks registering standard letter, number, or arrow keys as global hotkeys without Ctrl, Alt, Shift, or Win so they don't break normal typing in every program. Dedicated media keys (Play/Pause, Next, Previous, Volume) work without modifiers.
VolumeMixerHint: Per-player volume adjusts the app's audio session in the Windows Volume Mixer, not the internal slider inside the player UI.
TooltipChooseStartupSound: Choose a custom audio file (.wav, .mp3, .m4a, .wma, up to 5 MB).
TooltipResetStartupSound: Reset to the default startup chime.
StartupSoundTooLarge: Audio file is empty or exceeds the 5 MB limit.
Inst_Step1Subtitle: Choose installation location, mode, and shortcuts.
Inst_PortableMode: Portable mode (store settings next to the app, no system integration)
Inst_LanguageCatalogHint: Only selected languages will be available in the installed app.
Inst_Step2Subtitle: Configure player and hotkeys before the first launch.
Inst_HotkeysHeader: Initial hotkeys (click to record, right-click to reset):
Inst_Step3Subtitle: Please wait while Music Media Keys is being installed.
Inst_Step4Subtitle: Music Media Keys is configured and ready to use.
Inst_InvalidInstallDirectory: Please choose a dedicated application folder (not a drive root, network path, or system folder).
Inst_NewFolderPrompt: Enter a subfolder name to append to the installation path (created during installation):
Inst_NewFolderInvalidName: Please enter a valid folder name without slashes or invalid characters.
Inst_TooltipInstallFolder: Destination directory where Music Media Keys will be installed.
Inst_TooltipNewFolder: Add a new subfolder to the installation path (created during installation).
Inst_TooltipPortableMode: Keep settings and logs next to the executable without writing shortcuts, registry entries, or tasks.
Inst_TooltipDesktopShortcut: Place a shortcut to Music Media Keys on your Desktop.
Inst_TooltipStartMenuShortcut: Add Music Media Keys to the Windows Start Menu.
Inst_TooltipLaunchNow: Start Music Media Keys right after closing the installer.
Inst_TooltipUninstallRemoveData: Also remove saved settings, custom startup sound, and logs.
Inst_UninstallDesc: The application, shortcuts, and scheduled tasks will be removed from your system.
Inst_UninstallRemoveData: Also delete user settings and logs
Inst_UninstallComplete: Music Media Keys has been removed.
